text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find exactly where and why the problem happens. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and stack traces, can help you locate errors quickly. However, tools alone are not enough. You should also follow a systematic approach: test one change at a time, check your assumptions, and keep notes about what you try. Logging is another useful strategy. By adding log messages to your code, you can see what the program is doing and spot unexpected behaviour. With patience and these methods, most bugs can be solved.
